Supreme Court Dismisses PIL on Social Media Content Removal

The Supreme Court of India has rejected a Public Interest Litigation (PIL) that sought the removal of social media content deemed to be causing communal disharmony, threatening national integrity, or undermining the judiciary. Chief Justice Surya Kant, part of the bench, advised against over-reacting to such content while dismissing the plea.
